keepers-lamp: A steady beam from the lamp that kept ships off the rocks for a hundred years.
last-winter: The cold of the last winter the oldest ones remember, called down all at once.
welcome-home: The way the house greets you at the door: it holds on. The target can't switch out next turn.
summit: A Champion taught it this. Uses the user's better attacking stat. Once a battle, at full HP, it can't miss.
the-long-game: A Champion taught it this. Uses the user's better attacking stat. 10 more power for each turn the user has been out, up to 40 more.
with-you: A Champion taught it this. Uses the user's better attacking stat. It hits harder with Bond: 92 power at Bond 4, 100 at the highest Bond.
seen-it: A Champion taught it this. Uses the user's better attacking stat. Once a battle, it goes first against a Pokémon that has only just come in.
house-call: A radio's crackle and a house's warmth, down the line. The user restores half its HP.
